dispute.claim_text: The driver never came at all. I wait at my condo guardhouse almost 15 minutes, call him also cannot get through, then he cancel and charge me $8! Eight dollars for a car that never turned up. I want my money back and I want somebody to call me about this.

counterparty_statement.text: I was at the main guardhouse for nearly ten minutes. I messaged twice with my plate, she read it, she replied she is coming in two minutes, I called her and she picked up and said the same thing. I waited another two and a half minutes. Six seater booking, I turned down two other jobs for this.

admissibility.notes: Cancelled trip record, causally ordered, zone class LARGE_VENUE, RYDE_XL tier, and it carries the answered in-app call at 16:09:40.

pickup.label: The Interlace, Main Guardhouse, 180 Depot Rd

dropoff.label: NTUC FairPrice Xtra, VivoCity, 1 HarbourFront Walk

admissibility.notes: Unbroken 10 s telemetry, 100% coverage, both tracks present. The driver holds the guardhouse for 585 s; the rider's device never leaves the Block 5 lift lobby 640 m inside the estate.
Six entries including a VOICE_CALL_LOG line. Every message delivered and read, including the rider's own 'coming coming 2 min'.

messages.text: hello ma'am i'm at the main guardhouse, white Honda Vezel SJK8842P
Voice call placed by driver, 0:34, answered

admissibility.notes: The 8.00 cancellation fee reconciles with the RYDE_XL six-seater tier on the trip record, so POL-NS-08(d) is not engaged.

Three prior no-show flags are recorded. Under the fairness constraint they may inform credibility weighting only and can never carry the adverse finding, which rests on the GPS and trip record for this trip.

issue_details.detail: No advisory covers Depot Road in this window.
